title: Conflict-safe explicit Save
description: Direct patch does not satisfy the explicit Save and conflict-safe transaction contract.
rationale: A direct-patch exception must remain allowlisted, concurrency-safe, and GET-reconciled.
remediation: Use explicit Save, a minimal clientEditable patch, a fresh digest, exact ETag, 412 conflict handling, GET-only reconciliation, and semantic readback.

residualGate.description: Concurrent tenant saves and ambiguous transport outcomes remain external.
